title: opscotch Test configuration
description: The test configuration for the opscotch test runner

ignore.description: If true the test will not be run

fromDirectory.description: The relative path from the test directory to the test resources

testThisStep.description: The name of the workflow step to trigger for the test

useThisTestConfigFile.description: The workflow configuration file to load for the test

useThisTestBootstrapFile.description: The bootstrap configuration to include for the test

mockEndpointResponses.description: The mocked HTTP responses the test runner should serve

theseMetricsShouldHaveBeenSent.description: The metrics that are expected to be generated by the workflow configuration

theseLogsShouldHaveBeenSent.description: The logs that are expected to be generated by the workflow configuration

logsShouldNotContain.description: The log fragments that must not be generated by the workflow configuration

makeTheseCalls.description: HTTP calls to make against the agent and assert the response

timestampOverride.description: A millisecond timestamp used to override the system clock during the test

secondsToWaitForCompletion.description: How long to wait for logs and metric assertions before the test stops

data.description: Additional JSON data to merge into the test configuration

manifest.description: Workflow manifest manipulations to apply before the test runs

manifestInclude.description: A workflow source to include in the manifest

sourceWorkflow.description: Relative path to a workflow JSON file under the test's fromDirectory

sourceValue.description: Value to assign or append when the operation requires one

mockHttpResponse.description: The mocked HTTP response the test runner should return

whenThisIsCalled.description: The complete URL that the mock server will listen for

expectedPayload.description: If set, asserts the exact payload that was received

returnThisFile.description: The file path of the response to return

returnThisBody.description: The response body to return directly

withMethod.description: The HTTP method expected for the request

thisManyTimes.description: The number of times this endpoint should be invoked

delay.description: The number of milliseconds to delay the response

sendMetricVerification.description: An expected metric emitted by the workflow configuration

timestamp.description: Assert the exact timestamp on the metric, otherwise the timestamp is ignored

dimensionMap.description: Assert that the received and expected dimensions are exact

httpCall.description: An HTTP call to make against the agent and assert the response

expectedSize.description: The expected size of the response

headers.description: The HTTP headers to use as key/value pairs

timeoutSeconds.description: The allowed timeout of the HTTP call in seconds
